text.sr: Rezultat počinje kao prazan objekat. Ako je ulaz prazan, upravo njega vraćamo (linija sa `return`).
text.en: The result starts as an empty object. If the input is empty, that is exactly what we return (the `return` line).

text.sr: Prolazimo kroz elemente redom, pa je redosled u grupi isti kao u ulaznom nizu. `keyFn(item)` daje ključ tog elementa.
text.en: We go through the elements in order, so the order inside a group is the same as in the input array. `keyFn(item)` gives the key of that element.

text.sr: Zatvaraju se petlja i funkcija; vraćamo objekat sa grupama. Ulazni niz se samo čita, nikad ne menja.
text.en: The loop and the function are closed; we return the object with the groups. The input array is only read, never changed.

note.sr: Elementi se ubacuju u postojeći niz, pa je rešenje linearno. `Object.hasOwn` štiti od nasleđenih svojstava.
note.en: Elements are pushed into an existing array, so the solution is linear. `Object.hasOwn` protects against inherited properties.

text.sr: `reduce` prolazi kroz niz i nosi sa sobom akumulator `groups`; početna vrednost je prazan objekat `{}` (poslednji argument, vidi liniju sa `}, {});`). Za prazan niz `reduce` odmah vraća početnu vrednost, pa dobijamo `{}`.
text.en: `reduce` goes through the array and carries an accumulator `groups`; the starting value is an empty object `{}` (the last argument, see the line `}, {});`). For an empty array `reduce` returns the starting value right away, so we get `{}`.
The key of the current element.

text.sr:
Uzimamo postojeću grupu ili prazan niz ako je još nema.

- `Object.hasOwn(groups, key)` pita da li objekat ima sopstveno svojstvo sa tim ključem (zašto ne `groups[key] ?? []`: ključ `'constructor'` bi našao nasleđenu funkciju umesto praznog mesta).
- `uslov ? a : b` je ternarni operator: ako je uslov tačan, rezultat je `a`, inače `b`.
text.en:
We take the existing group or an empty array if there is none yet.

- `Object.hasOwn(groups, key)` asks whether the object has its own property with that key (why not `groups[key] ?? []`: the key `'constructor'` would find an inherited function instead of an empty place).
- `condition ? a : b` is the ternary operator: if the condition is true the result is `a`, otherwise `b`.

text.sr: Spread raspakuje postojeću grupu u nov niz, uz njega ide `item`, i taj nov niz postaje grupa pod ključem `key`.
text.en: Spread unpacks the existing group into a new array, `item` goes next to it, and that new array becomes the group under the key `key`.

text.sr: Vraćamo akumulator da ga `reduce` prosledi sledećem koraku; poslednji akumulator je rezultat funkcije. Linija `}, {});` zatvara strelicu i daje početnu vrednost, prazan objekat.
text.en: We return the accumulator so `reduce` passes it to the next step; the last accumulator is the result of the function. The line `}, {});` closes the arrow and gives the starting value, an empty object.

note.sr: Svaki korak kopira grupu, pa je sporije za velike grupe (kvadratno). Rešenje sa petljom i `push` je brže.
note.en: Every step copies the group, so it is slower for large groups (quadratic). The loop solution with `push` is faster.
